Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner improperly reframed the task to a US-only release context (and even proposed using unverified US home-video dates) despite the question not specifying a region. This led to the interim conclusion that Taxi zum Klo was released first, contradicting the globally earlier 1978 release of Saajan Bina Suhagan. The error stemmed from failing to resolve conflicting sources by authoritative disambiguation and shifting criteria without justification.
